pin_id_gotchas: JER-01,JER-02 is Jericho (Tell es-Sultan), not Jerusalem.
Jerusalem OT dig cards: COD-01,COD-02,COD-04 (City of David), COD-03 (Gihon).
Jerusalem NT cards include JER-NT-01…05 and WW-01; do not merge with Jericho.
SAM-01 exists on both ot-digs and nt-digs (same Sebaste/Samaria place). Use layer when disambiguating cards.

wire.attach_as: Alias index for the floating top search bar. Match against display_name and every aliases[].name.

examples: Tell es-Sultan ≈ Tel es-Sultan ≈ Tall es-Sultan

wire.results_hint: When the hit matched an alias (not the display_name), show a secondary line: also called {matched_alias}.
wire.disputed: If row.disputed_identification is true, keep the alias searchable but show the pin's existing confidence/caveat chrome; do not promote a contested ID as settled.
wire.lsb_refs: Included only when already present on the pin (verses field). Do not add new refs from this pack.
